parameters.name: All
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to unbind all tags from the resource. This parameter takes effect only if TagKey.N is not set in the request. Valid values:

- true: All tags are unbound from the resource.
- false: Not all tags are unbound from the resource.

Default value: false.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the resource. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: ResourceId
parameters.description: The resource ID. Valid values of N: 1 to 50.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description: The type of the resource. Only scaling groups are supported. Set the value to scalinggroup.

parameters.name: TagKey
parameters.description: The tag key of the resource. Valid values of N: 1 to 20.
